scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && tsx watch src/apps/api/src/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @codeagent-sandbox-demo/core && npm run build -w @codeagent-sandbox-demo/fc-e2b-provider
scripts.fc:e2b:recovery-smoke: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && node tools/fc-e2b/recovery-smoke.mjs
scripts.fc:e2b:oss-replacement-smoke: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && node tools/fc-e2b/oss-replacement-smoke.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p src/apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
